product.name: Graf One2Clean Plus Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The One2Clean Plus sewage treatment plant from Graf will treat the water, so that it is clean enough to be discharged into a water course (depending on how frequently it is being used and the manufacturer’s guidelines). However, One2Clean Plus sewage treatment plants do require a power source and requires emptying approximately every year.
The water discharged from the One2Clean Plus packaged treatment plant must meet the relevant British Standard which is BS EN 12566 for small sewage treatment plants and BS 6297:2007 for drainage fields.
Graf One2Clean Plus Sewage Treatment Plant Process

Untreated waste enters the One2Clean tank via the inlet on the side.
Wastewater then falls directly into the biological zone where the treatment takes place, allowing micro-organisms to start the breakdown process.
Compressed air is used initially for aeration through the diffuser, intermittent to achieve the best treatment performance.
Aeration is then stopped allowing the activated waste to sink to the bottom.
Compressed air is sent through the One2Clean tank once again, extracting the cleaned water near the surface.
This water passes through a sampling point before leaving the plant, where samples can be taken to confirm the quality of effluent.
The above process occurs twice per day, each lasting 12 hours.
The sludge which builds up at the bottom of the tank must also be emptied in line with the manufacturer’s instructions
Numerous companiescan dispose of the waste, these must be a registered waste carrier

Features & Benefits

One tank with just one chamber
Less energy consumption
No mechanical elements in the wastewater
No pumps in the wastewater
No electrical components in the wastewater
Incredibly low volume of sewage sludge
Odourless, clear treated water for extraction
State-of-the-art manufacturing for maximum stability
100% watertight and corrosion-resistant
Can be installed in groundwater
Simple maintenance via an integrated, self-cleaning sampling container
More advanced control panel than the standard One2Clean
Control panel allows additional plug in retro fitting of add on systems

product.name: Graf Carat Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvester Package
product.description: Designed for outdoor cleaning and irrigation purposes, the Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvesting system by Graf is ideal for collecting rainwater from the roof of your property and then feeding it into the underground tank via the downpipes. Available in various sizes, you can use the harvester for domestic or commercial use with the choice of either an A15 lid for pedestrian use or a B125 cast iron lid for light vehicular use.Before entering the underground tank, the water passes through a filter to remove debris, ensuring clear water for use. An underground pressure-sensitive pump is also installed. When a valve or tap is opened, the water is pumped under pressure until the valve is closed allowing the system to re-pressurise and turn off the power to the pump.Features & Benefits: Graf Carat Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvester PackageLightweight for easy handling and transportationEasy and safe to assembleA15 and B125 lid options and choice of harvester sizes availableEPDM used to profile sealings and ensure minimum life of 25 yearsConstant monitoring of production ensures consistent qualitySuitable for vehicle loading when a telescopic cast iron cover is usedTwo additional hose-lock connection extraction pointsFilter prevents leaves, moss and debris from travelling with the rainwater out of the tankFilter package 2 consists of an internal Universal Filter 3, an inflow stilling system for controlling the water inflow as well as a Spannfix connection sleeve, Rodent Guard and an Overflow siphon. The Integra Inox Submersible pump features an automatic start/stop function with a floating water extraction unit and protection against dry running.Please note: If you have an above-ground tank, you can use a pump to extract the rainwater. However, if the tank is underground, you'll need a pump to extract the rainwater. It's important to consider what you'll be using the harvested rainwater for, as this will determine whether you need a backup function for periods where little rainwater is collected.

product.name: Graf Klaro E Professional Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plants by Graf are always a good choice. They are flexibly adapted to meet the stricter discharge values in water protection areas. No live parts need to be installed in the Klaro E Professional. Movement processes are created by three air lift pumps that are operated using a compressor which is built into the control.
The Graf Klaro E Professional wastewater treatment system does not need consistent integration of live technology in the tank. Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plant can be flexibly adjusted to changing conditions by altering the cycle times. The air pressure holes are colour coded to avoid installation errors; the whole system just needs to be fitted to the baffle of the reservoir.

No live technology in the reservoir
Air compressor is very durable and whisper-quiet
Flexible, as expandable
Can be switched to holiday mode
Easy to install
Low maintenance
10-year warranty on sewage reservoirs
2-year warranty on technology

product.name: Freefoam Square Edge uPVC Fascia Board Joiner
product.description: From Freefoam’s variety of fascia accessories, this square edge joiner works by easily joining your fascia boards together while leaving an appropriate amount of space to allow for thermal expansion. Made from hardwearing and reliable uPVC, this square edge joiner is stable and defensive against UV damage that may occur due to outdoor use – such as discolouration, cracking, distorting and, like other Freefroam fascia products, it withstands air pollution excellently. This means that your joiner will efficiently hold together two fascia boards while maintaining a sleek, untarnished surface. product.description: This Doubled Ended Square Leg/Plain Fascia/Reveal Liner has been manufactured to last and is available in a range of widths with a variety of colours featuring Freefoam patented Colormax technology and woodgrain finishes produced with market-leading Renolit Exofol with built-in Solar Shield Technology, reducing heat absorption and minimalizing profile temperature and expansion.Perfect for improving existing wood fascia boards without a full replacement and completely removing the original fascia boards, this fascia board is ideal for protecting your existing fascia system and providing a professional, clean finish with a stylish and modern appearance. With a smooth, hard-wearing, strong skin, this fascia board is coated with robust uPVC and has a strong PVC-UE foam ‘core’. Made with extra Titanium Dioxide, this uPVC double-ended fascia board is protected from UV damage, so it looks good and lasts for longer, resisting discolouration with a 20-year guarantee for the white fascia board and a 10-year guarantee for the coloured fascia boards. This environmentally friendly solution is 100% lead-free.

product.name: Freeflow Half Round Plastic Gutter Fascia Bracket
product.description:
Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: Freeflow Plastic Ogee Gutter Internal Stopend
product.description:
The Freeflow ogee gutter system includes a traditional ‘s’ curved style gutter with a complete range of matching fittings to ensure a water-tight professional installation. An additional benefit for customers is the symmetrical shape of the ogee gutter which eliminates the need to stock a range of left and right hand parts. The gutter is 135mm wide, 77mm deep and is 4m long. All ogee gutter system parts are available in white, black, brown and caramel. Square or round pipe systems may be fitted to the ogee gutter system.Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: Fernco Puddle Flange for Drain Pipes
product.description: Formerly Flexseal, Fernco Puddle Flanges serve the purpose of sealing the area around pipes that pass through concrete structures like tanks, manhole chambers, shafts, floor slabs and basements. Manufactured from sturdy EPDM, these reliable flanges are typically installed during the construction phase.When pipes pass through concrete, they do not bond to the concrete, creating a potential route for water to flow along the external surface of the pipe. However, Fernco Puddle Flanges act as a barrier, preventing water penetration in such situations. The flange is clamped onto the pipe, obstructing this direct water route. During the pouring process, the seal body is compressed, and if the concrete shrinks during curing, the rubber in the flange relaxes and maintains a seal, preventing any water flow along this path.Features & Benefits: Fernco Puddle Flange for Drain PipesHighly versatile, cost-effective solution for sealing pipes which pass through concreteSuitable for use in walls, floors and ceilingsGood chemical resistanceQuick & easy to installAvailable in a wide range of sizes

product.name: Fernco HDPE Penstock Valve Extension Spindle Set
product.description: Effortlessly control penstock valves with Fernco's Telescopic HDPE Penstock Valve Extension Spindle Set. Ideal for below-ground or pit installations, these sets offer remote operation. Choose from a range of sizes to match your specific needs for seamless water flow management.To install your extension spindle, start by removing the BS cap. Then, place the extension spindle over the penstock spindle. Position the upper bracket 150mm below the deck or the top of the spindle extension. Divide the remaining brackets evenly over the length of the spindle extension, using one additional bracket for every 3m. Mark the mounting holes for the brackets to ensure the extension spindle is in the correct position. Remove the spindle extension and install the brackets as required. Finally, reinstall the spindle extension and adjust the bracket positions as needed to ensure proper alignment.Features & Benefits: Fernco HDPE Penstock Valve Extension Spindle SetAllows remote valve control of your penstockDesigned for below-ground or pit installationsVarious sizes available to suit specific requirementsSimplifies water flow managementQuick and easy installation

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron H460D Castellated Hopper Head
product.description: Castellated with decorative trimming, this hopper head helps to funnel rainwater into the downpipes and drains below. Made from robust, reliable and strong cast iron, this hopper head has been tried and tested to endure many difficulties such as mechanical de-blocking, vandalism and on-site handling and can withstand the long life of a building.Manufactured from infinitely recyclable cast iron, this hopper head is fully sustainable and will not end up in a landfill like plastic. Flame resistant and non-combustible, this hopper head does not require fire collars or extra lagging etc. and has excellent sound-dampening properties. This hopper head is perfect for refurbishment, restoration, heritage and conservation work as well as bespoke, unique and new designs on commercial, domestic, industrial and public buildings. Once installed, this hopper head is recommended to have annual inspections, but remedial action is not usually needed with minimal maintenance requirements. This hopper head can tolerate weights such as heavy snow or ladders.Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron H460D Castellated Hopper HeadStrong, durable and reliable cast iron material  Good noise dampening properties due to very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures meaning no creaking or clicking and does not rattle in high winds  Made from 100% recyclable, sustainable cast iron  Made to British Standards of BS EN 77, BBA approved 06/4401 and certified by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754  UKCA and CE approved  Cost-effective in the long term  Minimal maintenance needed with a long-lasting installation  Withstands weights such as heavy snow or ladders  Flame resistant and non-combustibleAvailable in a range of downpipe diameters to fit your downpipes, this hopper head has been painted black in factory conditions by paint specialists. Providing a good paint finish is vital to the longevity and performance of your hopper head and protects the underlying substrate and creates a barrier between the Cast Iron and corroding elements.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Rectangular Downpipe Side Offset
product.description:
This rectangular downpipe side offset is available in a range of diameters and is compatible with the Hargreaves rectangular pipes and fittings. Made from tried and tested cast iron, this offset is strong, reliable and durable, withstanding the difficulties of on-site handling, vandalism and mechanical de-blocking.With good sound dampening properties, this side offset is also non-combustible requiring no extra lagging, fire collars etc. Manufactured from 100% recyclable cast iron, this side offset is fully sustainable and can withstand the long life of a building and unlike plastic, will not end up in a landfill. Suitable for conservation, heritage, refurbishment and restoration work as well as bespoke, new and unique designs on commercial, industrial, public or domestic buildings, this side offset has low maintenance requirements once installed with annual inspections recommended but remedial action is not usually needed.
Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron Rectangular Downpipe Side OffsetAvailable in a range of sizes with your choice of primed or painted black  Primed offset painted using RAL 7024 dark grey and can be top-coated with Epoxy, Acrylic or Polyurethane paint  Internally and externally painted  Low sound levels due to very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures, therefore, no clicking or creaking and not rattling in high winds  Durable, reliable and strong cast iron material  Made from sustainable, 100% recyclable cast iron  Made to British Standards of BS EN 877, BBA approved 06/4401 and certified by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754  UKCA and CE approved  Cost-effective with long-lasting, minimal maintenance, fire resistance and good sound dampening properties
With your choice of painted black or primed side offset, this offset is internally and externally painted. The painted offset provides an excellent paint finish which is vital to the longevity and performance of your Cast Iron offset, protecting the underlying substrate by providing a barrier between the Cast Iron and corroding elements and carried out by paint specialists in factory conditions. The primed side offset is coated in a dark grey primer which provides a surface that subsequent coats of paint can effortlessly adhere to, providing temporary protection to the surface and creating a barrier to corrosion until it can be overcoated with Acrylic, Polyurethane or Epoxy paint.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Rectangular Downpipe Plain Earband
product.description: This cast iron rectangular downpipe plain earband is designed to hold a rectangular downpipe in place against a wall. By choosing cast iron, you're deciding to use a sustainable and durable material that can withstand a variety of factors. Sustainability means it can be fully recycled after its lifetime use and not 'downcycled' like other materials. For resistance, it is highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism. The cast iron can also withstand the weight of ladders, storms and heavy snow. With potential longevity lasting over 100 years if installed and maintained correctly. Though maintenance is minimal, occasional painting is required approximately every 10 years. Low noise levels are thanks to the sound of deadening properties of cast iron and they won't rattle in high winds. When exposed to extreme temperatures this also has very little effect on the expansion and contraction of the material. So no noisy clicking or creaking sounds of the gutter are apparent.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Rectangular Downpipe Branch
product.description:
Rectangular rainwater pipes come in a choice of 100mm x 75mm, 125mm x 70mm, 125mm x 100mm and 150mm x 100mm diameters and in standard lengths of 0.6m, 0.9m, 1.2m and 1.8m. Produced by the vertical cast method which offers uniformity of shape and thickness. The premier standard rainwater range includes 8 gutter profiles in a variety of different sizes with capacities up to 3L per second.
Cast Iron is a sustainable material, this means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'. Premier pipes are highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism. Cast iron gutters are able to withstand the weight of ladders, storms and heavy snow. Correctly installed and maintained Premier Systems can last in excess of 100 years with minimal maintenance requirements - occasional painting approximately every 10 years.
Cast iron is very quiet in operation, with low noise levels due to the sound deading properties of cast iron and they wont rattle in high winds. They have very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of guttering. All Premier rainwater products are manufactured in accordance with BS460.
Bespoke

Any system can be pre-painted in any RAL colour.
Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building.
Ears can be added to any standard fitting.
Hopper heads can be customised with dates or embellishments.

Prices on application please call for details.

product.description: For fantastic longevity performance, this round downpipe offset bend is constructed from comprehensive cast iron that remains perfectly intact while linking guttering to downpipe systems. product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Round Eared Double Socket Downpipe
product.description:
Cast Iron is a sustainable material. This means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled' produced by the veritcal cast method which offers uniformity of shape and thickness. The Premier standard rainwater range now lncludes 8 gutter profiles in a variety of different sizes with capacities up to 3L per second.Premier pipes are highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism, the gutters will not bend or sag when subjected to heavy snow and storms. Correctly installed and maintained Premier rainwater systems can last in excess of 100 years. Its also 100% recyclable at the end of its life.Low noise levels due to the sound deadening properties of cast iron. Very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of gutters they will also not rattle in high winds.Bespoke

Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building
Radius curved gutters can be made to match any standard profile
Hopper heads can be customised with dates of embellishments
Can be made to any RAL colour

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Notts OG Gutter External Stopend
product.description: Compatible with the Cast Iron Notts OG rainwater gutters, this external stopend can be used at the end of the gutter run to close off the guttering. Manufactured from reliable, durable and strong cast iron, this stopend has been tried and tested, withstanding multiple difficulties such as vandalism, on-site handling and mechanical de-blocking.This fully sustainable stopend is made from infinitely recyclable cast iron, can survive the long life of a building and will not end up in a landfill like plastic. Suitable for bespoke, unique and new designs as well as conservation, restoration, heritage and refurbishment work on domestic, public, industrial or commercial buildings, this stopend has minimal maintenance requirements. With suggested annual inspections once installed, remedial action is not normally needed. This non-combustible and flame resistant stopend does not require fire collars or extra lagging etc and has good sound dampening properties with minimal expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures and no rattling in high winds.Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron Notts OG Gutter External StopendAvailable with your choice of primed or painted black  Painted black in factory conditions by paint specialists  Primed using RAL 7024 dark grey and can be coated with Epoxy, Acrylic or Polyurethane paints  Externally and internally painted  Withstands the weight of ladders or heavy snow  Long-lasting installation with low maintenance requirements  Good noise dampening properties and fire-resistant  Made from sustainable, 100% recyclable cast iron  Cost-effective in the long term  Manufactured to British Standards of BS EN 877, BBA approved 06/4401 and certified by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754  UKCA and CE approvedAvailable in painted black or primed, this stopend is painted internally and externally. The painted black stopend provides a good paint finish which is vital to the performance and longevity of your gutters, protecting the underlying substrate by creating a barrier between the corroding elements and Cast Iron. The primed stopend is coated in a dark grey primer which provides a surface for subsequent coats of paint to easily adhere to. Providing temporary protection to the surface, the primed layer creates a barrier to corrosion until it can be overcoated with Acrylic, Epoxy or Polyurethane paint.
